subject: Short pilot: top-up options and surge assurance request
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@tessera.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@tessera.ai
Date: 2025-08-11T09:17:00Z
Subject: Pilot nearing end — need top-up and surge assurance

Hi Michael,

Quick note as our time-boxed pilot with Redwood wraps up next Friday — we've seen an unexpected production-like spike in traffic this week. The team is excited (good signals), but procurement and engineering are asking for two things before we move to a formal evaluation: a short-term top-up option (we can buy a block of capacity/credits) and a formal "surge assurance" add-on so we don't get throttled if usage keeps spiking through the remainder of the pilot.

Can you walk me through pricing for:
- A one-off top-up (how many tokens/hours would cover ~3x our current burn for 7 days and the cost)
- A surge-assurance add-on (is this priced as a bucket? flat fee? discount for committing to an extra burst?)

Procurement has asked for an amendment/invoice stub they can approve (they prefer a simple invoice vs more contract work). If there's any discount you can offer for short-term top-ups, that would help speed approval.

We're happy to hop on a 20-min call today or tomorrow if easier — Sarah (engineering) and accounts are on cc.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Head of ML Ops | Tessera AI

Attachment: pilot_usage_report.csv (summary export)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@tessera.ai>
Cc: accounts@tessera.ai, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-11T12:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot nearing end — need top-up and surge assurance

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the early improvement signals.

Two pragmatic options that map to what procurement usually accepts:

1) Short-term credit block (fastest):
   - We can provision a 7-day top-up bucket sized to ~3x your current burn. Rough estimate: 150k token-equivalent / $4,500 at list pricing.
   - We can apply a 10% pilot discount for one-off top-ups (no long-term commitment).
   - Delivery: we can invoice and provision immediately after PO or card payment.

2) Surge assurance add-on (operational guarantee):
   - Temporary dedicated burst pool for the remainder of the pilot (configurable cap).
   - Pricing as a fixed surcharge + token consumption at a discounted rate. For short pilots we typically do a flat $3,000 surcharge + 15% off token rate for the burst bucket.
   - Requires a short amendment that includes a pre-surge notification window (recommended 24 hours) and a defined burst cap.

If procurement needs a simple invoice amendment, I can draft that and route to legal/finance. Lauren, can you confirm whether a 15% discount for the surge add-on is OK to approve? David, can you confirm ops can spin up the temporary burst pool and the expected time-to-provision?

If either option works, happy to schedule a 20-min sync today.

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0194

Attachment: pilot_usage_report.csv (attached — same as Sarah's export)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@tessera.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-12T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot nearing end — need top-up and surge assurance

Michael / Sarah — quick internal check and response:

We can approve a 12% pilot discount on the surge-assurance add-on for this short extension (we usually stop at 10% for unilateral approvals). A couple of constraints:
- Discount only applies to the burst bucket consumption, not to historical usage.
- Any invoice/amendment needs finance signoff (I will loop in finance once the amendment draft is ready).
- The amendment should be limited in duration to the remaining pilot window (explicit start/end dates) and include the pre-surge notification clause.

Michael — please send the amendment draft (simple one-pager) and I'll get finance on it. Sarah — can you confirm the expected max burst (tokens/hr) you want covered so ops can size the pool?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-08-13T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot nearing end — need top-up and surge assurance

Confirming ops availability and a few operational notes:

- We can provision a temporary burst pool for the rest of the pilot. Typical lead time to carve and route is ~4 hours once finance/invoice is in place.
- Recommend the 24-hour pre-surge notification (engineering sends a short heads-up) so we can ensure KV cache warm-up and avoid cold-thrashing.
- Risk note: if burst exceeds the agreed cap by >30% we will auto-throttle until we get confirmation; we should document this in the amendment.

Attached is a lightweight amendment template that does the following: defines the burst cap, start/end times, surcharge amount, discount percentage, invoicing flow, and the pre-surge notification requirement. Sarah — please confirm the burst cap you want (e.g., 20k tokens/min or 1.2M tokens/day) and I'll lock in the provisioning window.

Next steps: Michael to send amendment + final numbers; Lauren to run finance approval; I will stand by to provision on sign-off.

—David Kim
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Inference Operations | Redwood Inference
